messages:
Mina (acct-exec): Lyra vendor risk ping. They want SIG question set filled. Immediate asks: Q3.2 KMS rotation details + sample logs, Q5.1 SOC2 attestation (exec summary ok), and Q9.4 subprocessor disclosures. Also asked about short-term POC pricing for Dedicated. Can we triage owners?
Diego Ramos: I can own KMS rotation. We rotate keys on a 90-day cadence and keep rotation metadata in KMS audit logs. I have `kms-rotation-policy.pdf` and `rotation-sample-20250128.log` that I can scrub and upload.
Harpreet Singh: I'll take SOC2 exec summary and subprocessor list. Note: legal insists full SOC2 requires NDA; exec summary is shareable. I'll prepare `soc2-exec-summary-redacted.pdf` and `subprocessors-customer.csv` (redacted names where needed).
Claire Yu: POC pricing: for a 2-week Dedicated POC with single GPU and burst to 2 GPUs we quote $9,000 flat + per-token. I'll drop a briefly worded pricing blurb that Mina can paste into the SIG notes.
Mina (acct-exec): Great. sec-bot, please ingest when folks upload and give share links. Legal, flag anything that needs review.
sec-bot: Ingestion started. Tag uploads with customer=lyra. Please ensure PII scrubbed.
legal-bot: Confirming: subprocessor list needs to be redacted per policy. Exec SOC summary ok. If Lyra requests full SOC2, require NDA.
Diego Ramos: Uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/lyra/kms-rotation-policy.pdf and https://s3.redwood.internal/lyra/rotation-sample-20250128-scrubbed.log. Replaced key IDs with `key-<hash>`.
sec-bot: Files available: https://s3.redwood.internal/lyra/kms-rotation-policy.pdf, https://s3.redwood.internal/lyra/rotation-sample-20250128-scrubbed.log
Harpreet Singh: Uploaded SOC exec summary and subprocessor draft (redacted): https://s3.redwood.internal/lyra/soc2-exec-summary-redacted.pdf, https://s3.redwood.internal/lyra/subprocessors-redacted.csv @legal-bot review
legal-bot: Reviewing subprocessors-redacted.csv. Two vendor aliases need adjustment (can't use internal code names). ETA 2 hours.
Claire Yu: Pricing blurb: "2-week Dedicated POC: $9,000 flat + per-token consumption. Long-term commitments eligible for discounts. Contact pricing@redwood.com for contract terms."
Mina (acct-exec): Mapping -> Q3.2 = Diego (KMS doc + log), Q5.1 = Harpreet (SOC exec summary), Q9.4 = Harpreet (subprocessors). POC pricing noted separately. Any objections?
Diego Ramos: No objections. One note: rotation-sample includes hostnames; scrubbed them to `host-<hash>` as per ops.
Harpreet Singh: Legal cleared subprocessors with requested alias changes. Final file: https://s3.redwood.internal/lyra/subprocessors-final.csv
sec-bot: All artifacts verified and tagged: kms rotation, soc exec summary, subprocessors list. Checksums OK.
Mina (acct-exec): I'll assemble SIG spreadsheet now. Quick phrasing for Q3.2 from Diego: "Keys are rotated every 90 days; rotation policy and sample logs attached (kms-rotation-policy.pdf, rotation-sample-20250128-scrubbed.log)."
Diego Ramos: That works. For Q5.1 paste: "SOC2 Type II executive summary attached. Full SOC2 report available under NDA."
Harpreet Singh: For Q9.4 paste: "Subprocessor list attached (redacted); full list available under DPA terms."
Mina (acct-exec): I'll post the completed SIG answers here for a 30-min sanity check before I submit to Lyra procurement. Thanks all :raised_hands:
Claire Yu: One more question Lyra raised about encryption in transit. Standard line: "All customer traffic is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+). Private deployments support mTLS."
Mina (acct-exec): Added. Draft coming in ~20 mins. If legal needs anything else, ping me immediately.
